item.title: India News | Delhi HC Issues Notice on ED's Plea Challenging Interim Bail to Manoj Gaur on Mother's Health Condition
item.description: Get latest articles and stories on India at LatestLY. The Delhi High Court on Friday issued notice on the plea of Enforcement Directorate (ED) challenging the interim bail granted to Businessman Manoj Gaur former CMD of Jaypee Infratech Ltd on mother's health ground. Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani issued notice to respondent Manoj Gaur and sought reply. Advocate Dr. Farrukh Khan appeared for Manoj Gaur and accepted notice.

item.title: India News | Delhi HC Sets Aside Bail Rejection Based on 'voluminous Pleadings', Directs Fresh Hearing
item.description: Get latest articles and stories on India at LatestLY. The Delhi High Court has set aside an order of a trial court that dismissed a bail application solely on the ground that it was "too voluminous and bulky", and directed the trial court to reconsider the bail plea on merits within ten days after granting a proper hearing to both sides.
